label: Late original-phase consonant (n/r/c/w/f) after h/2/3/u/v in specific token contexts (hash-like)
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.005% of steps). 95% of mass is in the original phase at positions t=4-7 (peak t=5-6), almost never in copy/delimiter phases and never at t<4. Input is enriched for n/r/c/w/f, previous token for 2/h/v/u/3, first token for r/a/d/n, and early tokens b/u/q/j. It behaves like a conjunction over the whole prefix (a specific hidden-state configuration) rather than a simple rule: each added constraint raises precision only slightly (simple in_tok+prev_tok rule: P=0.004, mass recall 0.55; with orig(1)/orig(2) constraints: P=0.06, R=0.26). Magnitude is fairly uniform (median 0.116, max 0.173); top activations concentrate on sequences starting with r and containing b/q/u early. No coherent predicate reaches usable precision.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig2=b (+3.23), orig0=r (+3.17), orig0=a (+2.63), orig1=u (+2.63), orig0=d (+2.62), orig1=b (+2.56). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-3.19), orig_idx=-1 (-3.07), t=3 (-2.42).
